MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 3 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 3
   D. 15

2. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 56
   D. 1

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 23

4. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
